a.rust.struct_enum_match.roundtrip.moved: The pinned GAP was a lossy-text refusal naming `/enums[0]/layout` and the `/structs[0]/fields[*]/name` + `/offset` keys: text was layout-agnostic for enums and carried struct fields as a bare type list, so those fields were dropped without a spelling. trust-ir WS4.5 carries both — a `layout(..)` clause for the enum descriptor (narrowing `TextLoss::EnumLayout` to the internally inconsistent residual rather than deleting it) and `name: ty @off` for struct fields. Reaching PASS also needed the transport to stop canonicalizing; see the measured control recorded on the other roundtrip pins in this landing: 10 of 24 producer modules are non-canonical, and `bin -> text -> bin` is byte-identical 24/24 under `format::text_checked` (trust-ir bef296c7) against 14/24 under the canonicalize-first transport it replaced.
